The current draft proposes twelve student mediators, mediation sessions on Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch, one adult supervisor, and referrals for minor and moderate student conflicts. Before I can approve the operating plan, I need each of you to report on your assigned checklist item: the peer-mediation advisor needs to report the roster and training status, the counselor needs to report referral-screening requirements, and the school psychologist needs to report safety and supervision requirements. Let's go around the table — please give your report in one uninterrupted round, and I'll record everything along with any required plan changes before making my final decision. Who would like to start?
